title: Further proof transformations, modal logic, and ordinal analysis
details: Develop first-order sequent calculi and cut elimination with explicit substitution and eigenvariable conditions, followed by proof-theoretic Herbrand extraction. The propositional cut transformations and natural-deduction proof substitution provide prerequisites for this work. A separate constructive branch needs cut elimination for the full single-conclusion calculus and natural-deduction normalization before proof-based disjunction/existence extraction. Extend negative translations to first-order logic and Heyting arithmetic only after their constructive syntax, proof rules and arithmetic foundations have been developed. Heyting-algebra semantics needs its lattice foundations. Modal logic belongs in its own area. Ordinal analysis and Goodstein unprovability require genuine arithmetic-strength arguments; ordinal-descent termination does not supply an unprovability proof.
